capabilities: publish notes to a write.as collection or blog
update previously published posts via frontmatter IDs
configure write.as or a self-hosted WriteFreely instance in settings
add post URL and ID back into frontmatter
extras: README includes a disclosure that the plugin uses the internet and requires a write.as or WriteFreely account; API documentation is linked externally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a write.as or WriteFreely blog.

relations.evidence: Publish notes to or a self-hosted WriteFreely instance

summary: Publishing plugin that sends notes to write.as blogs or a self-hosted WriteFreely instance and keeps them updated.
